Life Series community statistics.
Lifetime totals in this world, not individual session changes. Only saved statistics are available. Inventories, advancements, custom lives and teams are separate data. Player skins are saved with the snapshot when available; unresolved accounts use a labeled default skin. Block models and textures: Minecraft 26.1 via PrismarineJS. 3D viewer: skinview3d / Three.js (MIT). General stats use representative items. Blocks use available models; other items use extruded sprites. Missing or modded assets use category icons. Fan-made; not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.
